name: mattpocock-skills-addons
description: Extensions to Matt Pocock's engineering skills that work through upstream's own per-repo config instead of wrapping or forking. Ships setup-triage-board, which gives triage a GitHub Projects board, and sync-triage-board, which moves cards when triage labels change. Requires the mattpocock-skills plugin. Hard dependency: every skill here extends an upstream skill and has nothing to do without it.
